description: This file provides utility functions used across the Git::SVN project, including URL and path canonicalization, compression checking, and error handling.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Displays an error message and exits with code 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available for compression.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path into its canonical form suitable for SVN API.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into its canonical form suitable for SVN API.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments into a single path, handling slashes appropriately.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a relative path component to a base URL, ensuring proper formatting.
